text:
sara_pm: Quick async check — pricing+packaging change: who owns the remaining integration pieces? Goal: feature-freeze by Fri EOD. Need clear owners for metering adapter, quota mapping, billing pipeline, and contract flags. Pls ping with short status.

alex_w: I own the metering adapter PR — https://git.redwood/infra/metering/merge/1234. CI is red due to an integration timeout on the AWS mock. Fixing tomorrow morning, should be a small test tweak.

mira_ml: Model-side pricing tiers are ready from our end (quantization tier mapping done). No product work needed yet. ETA to validation: Wed.

jonathan_eng: Quota mapping draft is in the sheet: https://docs.redwood/quotamap. One open question: semantics for soft vs hard quotas in contract layer. @nisha_billing — can you confirm expected enforcement behavior?

nisha_billing: Legal/product decided contract caps are hard (billing prevents issuance past cap). Soft quotas are advisory/telemetry. Filed BILL-789 to capture billing logic and edgecases, will assign Monday.

sara_pm: Thanks. For consistency let's standardize the contract flag name — proposal: `contract.max_units`. Everyone ok with that? @jonathan_eng pls reflect in mapping.

jonathan_eng: Updated mapping snippet here:```csv
plan_id,unit_name,max_units,quota_type
pro,token,1000000,hard
startup,token,200000,soft
```

alex_w: CI fix pushed — bumped test timeout and added a light AWS mock. Also bumped metering DB migration script to be idempotent. We'll need a canary window to run the migration; @kevin_sre any constraints?

kevin_sre: Canary window ok but prefer low-traffic hours. I can schedule 02:00-04:00 PST and add a rollback step. Will add runbook entry and require on-call presence.

metering-bot: Deploy scheduled by kevin_sre for 2026-03-20T02:00:00Z — canary reserved, alert hooks added.

sara_pm: Two outstanding items: final contract flag name (seems `contract.max_units` accepted) and billing backfill for existing customers. Is backfill in scope for initial launch? @nisha_billing

nisha_billing: Backfill is out-of-scope for the initial cut. We'll provide staged migration + credits for impacted customers and track in BILL-790.

jonathan_eng: I'll create backlog items for the backfill and mark them deferred for this milestone. OWNERS: alex_w (metering adapter), jonathan_eng (quota mapping), mira_ml (model pricing), nisha_billing (billing/backfill plan), kevin_sre (migration + canary).

sara_pm: Perfect — I'll update the roadmap and send a follow-up with action items + deadlines. If anyone will miss the Fri freeze, flag here ASAP. :thumbsup:

alex_w: small follow-up — after canary I'll open a post-rollout verification PR with quick checks (token counts, error rates). tagging @kevin_sre for signoff.

kevin_sre: noted, will schedule verification during canary.

sara_pm: Thanks team — closing this async thread, expect a short roadmap email in 30m.
